snippet.title: Bloodshed - Console Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bloodshed, the Roguelite Survivors FPS, is coming to console 23rd of October. Step into an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action on your console of choice!
